name: pixiform
description: Secure JavaScript form library rendered on canvas: encrypted passwords, shared validation, accessible, zero dependencies

scripts.serve: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.build:lib: rm -rf dist-lib && tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && vite build --config vite.lib.config.ts && vite build --config vite.lib.config.ts --mode standalone && vite build --config vite.lib.config.ts --mode ssr && node scripts/lib-package.mjs
scripts.build:site: tsc --noEmit && npm run build:lib && node scripts/build-site.mjs
scripts.deploy:site: npm run build:site && wrangler deploy && node scripts/indexnow.mjs
